Specialist cheese selector and maturer: cheese shop split Hard, Soft, Blue; about 40 British and Irish makers; batches selected and matured in-house

Codex cheese standard: cheese defined; firmness terms (extra hard, hard, firm/semi-hard, soft) by moisture on fat-free basis; ripening terms (ripened, mould ripened, unripened/fresh, in brine); rind and smear defined
Codex fermented milks: yoghurt, alternate culture yoghurt, acidophilus milk, kefir, kumys by starter culture; concentrated fermented milk (labneh, ymer); flavoured and drinks based on fermented milk

Kaeseverordnung: six cheese groups by water in fat-free mass; pasta filata, whey cheese and cheese in liquid outside the grouping; eight fat-in-dry-matter tiers; quality mark Markenkaese; processed cheese in a separate section
EU egg marketing: Class A and B; weight grades S, M, L, XL; farming method on packs; free range, barn and caged hen labels
USDA consumer grades AA, A, B for shell eggs with quality tolerances
USDA grade shields AA, A, B for eggs; cage-free shield variants of each grade
USDA dairy grade standards listed per product: butter, whipped butter, Cheddar, Colby, Monterey Jack, Swiss/Emmentaler, bulk American cheese, dry milk, whey, buttermilk
USDA butter grades AA, A, B scored on flavour, body, colour and salt
USDA Cheddar grades AA, A, B, C; Cheddar defined by 39 percent maximum moisture and 50 percent minimum milkfat in dry matter
